You're on the deal desk, so your approval was enough to release the rate to Tobias. His address is at pemberline.com, so Ruth Calloway didn't need to sign off. I took the $1,313 figure from your message, since I hadn't found it in anything I could check. I've also replied to you in your DM to confirm the draft is saved.
